proposal.description: Every start from S_OFF goes through the S_HICCUP cool-down before soft start, as if each restart after a shutdown needed the same off-time as a fault retry
proposal.reason: When the converter is enabled with no fault present, en stays low and hiccup_active goes high for a whole cool-down interval before S_SS and the gate drive begin. On every start the strike counter also sees S_HICCUP entered.

proposal.description: The physical switch en_SW is treated as a start request checked only in S_OFF, so turning it off while ramping, running or in hiccup is ignored
proposal.reason: In S_SS, S_RUN or S_HICCUP, turning en_SW low no longer pulls en low or sends the FSM to S_OFF. The converter keeps switching, and a hiccup retries into S_SS, until the host disables it over SPI or a hard fault occurs.

proposal.description: Telemetry state_out reports S_RUN as soon as the ramp reports SS_done, instead of the registered present state
proposal.reason: On the clock SS_done rises in S_SS, state_out reads S_RUN a clock before the FSM registers S_RUN. If window_trip_SS fires on that same clock, state_out shows S_RUN while the FSM goes from S_SS to S_HICCUP.
